name: development-skills
description: Marketplace of development-workflow plugins (spec-driven, board-tracked, TDD build loops).

plugins.name: spec-workflow
plugins.description: Spec-driven autonomous build workflow: GitHub Project board as source of truth, TDD via delegated dev agents, quality gate, checkpoint/handoff loop. Configured per-repo via .claude/project.yaml (versioned schema; legacy project.json still read).

plugins.name: scaffold-project
plugins.description: Scaffolds a new greenfield project's minikube dev-workflow (start/stop/dev/build/port-forward scripts + package.json wiring), with every profile bound explicitly from day one so scaffolded projects never collide on minikube's shared default profile.

plugins.name: peer-review
plugins.description: Independent, cross-vendor code review of the current diff via OpenAI's codex CLI -- deliberately never Claude reviewing its own diff, since that shares Claude's own blind spots.

plugins.name: remote-compute
plugins.description: Register remote machines (SSH, key-only) as user-level compute resources, advertise them to projects, and dispatch jobs/capability bundles to them. Requires the spec-workflow plugin (project overlay + config loader).

plugins.name: herdr
plugins.description: Teaches an agent to use Herdr, the terminal workspace manager for coding agents: start worktrees and agents, prompt them safely, listen to their work and see what is running. Standalone and thin over the herdr CLI; no workflow of its own.

plugins.name: herdr-graph-engineering
plugins.description: Graph engineering on Herdr: one orchestrator chat runs each idea as a lane (a worktree running a small graph of agent, gate and person steps from a pattern) until its definition of done, and comes to you only when a lane needs you. Requires the herdr plugin, jq, yq and git.

plugins.name: herdr-simple-orchestrate
plugins.description: DEPRECATED - the old way of orchestrating agents in Herdr: take the orchestrator role, and orchestrate a code review of related pull requests with reviewer agents in worktrees. Kept so existing setups keep working. Requires the herdr plugin.

plugins.name: herdr-development-skills
plugins.description: Integration layer between Herdr and the development-skills plugins: checks which plugins and features are enabled and configured, then runs spec-workflow tasks and build-loop lanes in Herdr worktree agents an orchestrator listens to. Requires the herdr plugin; degrades cleanly when a specialized plugin is absent.

plugins.name: ui-design
plugins.description: Mock a UI before it is built and let the human decide: 2-4 real options per decision, served on a local decision hub, audited for contrast and accessibility in both themes, with test ids and optional i18n, and the pick recorded in the page. Standalone; other skills may call it.
